implementation_comparison.dwa_evaluate_trajectory_with_braking: Evaluates continuous swept-circle clearance for dynamic obstacles (_swept_circle_clearance_m) and SimObjects, but evaluates ONLY pointwise _point_clearance() at trajectory endpoints for StaticObstacle AABBs and world boundaries.
implementation_comparison.metrics_compute_swept_clearance_m: Evaluates continuous segment-to-AABB swept clearance along [prev_pos, curr_pos] for StaticObstacle AABBs as well as swept-circle clearance for dynamic obstacles.
